name: start
title: Switch on or off a style

origin.description: The opening sequence of a style. finish() is the closing sequence, in reverse order.
origin.details: start is the crayon method of the stats generic. It is used when later output should stay in the style, for example a prompt. Both return an empty string when num_ansi_colors() is 1.

translation.description: The opening sequence of a style. finish() is the closing sequence, in reverse order.
translation.details: There is no stats generic here. start() and finish() take a crayon style. The open codes are concatenated in order; the close codes are concatenated from the inside out.
translation.value: The opening or closing sequence, or an empty string when color is off.
